name: rawStreamRead
description: Pull the next bytes of a rawStreamOpen stream. Resolves {done, errorCode?, errorMessage?, captured?} with the bytes on the `chunk` port. `done` means the response ended and every byte was delivered; the host then forgets the stream. Error codes on the final read: NETWORK_ERROR, TIMEOUT, RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE, CAPTURE_FAILED, CANCELLED.

inputs.name: waitMs
inputs.description: How long the host may hold the read for new bytes (capped at 30000). 0/absent = answer immediately.

inputs.name: maxBytes
inputs.description: Upper bound on bytes returned by this read. Default 1048576.
